reason: The DB-02 migration was replayed in a rolled-back transaction after fixing a stray END IF, then applied only once the replay was clean. That check is reusable for any Eventar migration and is not written down in any skill.

The window shows a pre-change audit (pg_proc x pg_get_functiondef ~* 'created_by', with EXECUTE grantees per function) that surfaced 12 SECURITY DEFINER functions touching a column. The migration skill has no step for enumerating dependent functions before altering a column, so a future session could change a column and miss a definer function's checks.
Dev-lens review found a rollback note pointing at a migration that did not define the function it claimed to restore. Grep-before-cite closes that class.
